hubs.name: Hinjewadi Phase 3 (Maan)
hubs.description: Rajiv Gandhi Infotech Park Western Terminal. Major tech employee hub (Infosys, TCS, Wipro, Megapolis).

hubs.name: Hinjewadi Shivaji Chowk (Phase 1)
hubs.description: Gateway to Hinjewadi IT park. Extreme bottleneck during morning (8:30-10:30 AM) and evening rush.

hubs.name: Wakad Bridge / NH48 Junction
hubs.description: Key junction connecting Hinjewadi, Baner, PCMC, and Bangalore-Mumbai bypass highway.

hubs.name: Baner / Balewadi Phata
hubs.description: Connects High Street, Balewadi Sports Complex and Pashan bypass.

hubs.name: Aundh / Rajiv Gandhi Bridge
hubs.description: High residential and commercial traffic corridor linking PCMC and Shivajinagar.

hubs.name: Pune University Chowk (SPPU)
hubs.description: Ganeshkhind Road flyover junction. Historic bottleneck for commuters between West Pune and City Center.

hubs.name: Shivajinagar Bus Station & Railway
hubs.description: Central multi-modal interchange linking PMPML, suburban railway, MSRTC, and Pune Metro Aqua Line.

hubs.name: PMC Bhavan (Ma Na Pa)
hubs.description: PMC headquarters central depot; origin for over 70 city bus routes across Mutha river.

hubs.name: Deccan Gymkhana (Goodluck Chowk)
hubs.description: Commercial heart of Pune on FC Road and Karve Road. High student and office commuter density.

hubs.name: Pune Railway Station Bus Terminal
hubs.description: Highest daily footfall gateway. Connects intercity express trains with round-the-clock PMPML fleet.

hubs.name: Swargate Multi-Modal Hub
hubs.description: Pune's biggest southern transport junction. PMPML depot, MSRTC terminal, and underground Metro terminus.

hubs.name: Katraj Bus Depot & Snake Park
hubs.description: Southern BRT terminal anchor on Pune-Satara Road. Major residential and educational catchment.

hubs.name: Hadapsar Gadital Terminal
hubs.description: Eastern gateway connecting Solapur Highway, Magarpatta Cybercity, and SP Infocity.

hubs.name: Magarpatta City (Tower Chowk)
hubs.description: Eastern IT park with heavy daily tech commuter transit demand.

hubs.name: Viman Nagar / Phoenix Mall
hubs.description: Nagar Road BRT corridor, close to Pune International Airport and Symbiosis campus.

hubs.name: Kharadi Bypass / EON IT Park
hubs.description: Major eastern tech corridor (EON IT Park, World Trade Center Pune) on Ahmednagar Highway.

hubs.name: Kothrud Depot / Paud Road
hubs.description: Densely populated residential and college district (MIT, Cummins) with dedicated PMPML depot.

hubs.name: Chandani Chowk / Bavdhan
hubs.description: Western bypass interchange connecting Mumbai-Bangalore Highway, Paud Road, and Mulshi.

hubs.name: Warje Flyover / Mai Mangeshkar
hubs.description: Connects Kothrud, Karvenagar, and Sinhagad Road via the bypass highway.

hubs.name: Sinhagad Road / Anand Nagar
hubs.description: One of Pune's most congested radial arterial corridors connecting Dhayari and Swargate.

hubs.name: Camp / Pulgate Stand
hubs.description: Pune Cantonment central terminal connecting East Pune, Kondhwa, and Pune Station.

hubs.name: Yerawada / Bund Garden Bridge
hubs.description: Bridge crossing over Mula-Mutha river connecting Station, Koregaon Park, and Nagar Road BRT.

hubs.name: Bhosari Bus Terminal (PCMC)
hubs.description: Northern industrial spine on Pune-Nashik highway, serving auto hubs (Tata Motors, MIDC).

hubs.name: Nigdi Bhakti Shakti Terminal
hubs.description: Old Mumbai-Pune Highway terminus. Major origin for BRT corridors into Pune city.

scenarios.title: Morning IT Corridor Surge (8:30 AM)
scenarios.description: Massive employee commute towards Hinjewadi IT Park and Shivajinagar. Extreme crowd bottlenecks at University Chowk, Wakad, and Swargate.

scenarios.title: Evening Commute Peak (6:45 PM)
scenarios.description: Reversal of commuters departing Hinjewadi, Magarpatta, and Camp. High crowd queues at bus terminals with major road congestion.

scenarios.title: Pune Festival & City Core Gridlock
scenarios.description: Central Pune heritage core (JM Road, Tilak Road, PMC, Deccan) severely overwhelmed. Dynamic optimizer routes through highway bypass ring.

scenarios.title: Off-Peak Balanced Transit (2:00 PM)
scenarios.description: Standard steady-state transit load. Dijkstra shortest path and crowd-optimized path align closely with minimal delay penalty.
